Definition: a covering, i.e. clothing; also treachery or pillage
BiblicalUsage: beged is the word for a garment — and, by extension, treachery, and it appears 190 times across the Bible. Holy garments for Aaron, raiment given to Rebekah, the priest changing his garments before carrying out the ashes — the word covers the clothing of worship, gift, and daily life.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe clothing in the Bible is never just cloth — it shows who a person is, what office they hold, and whether they are mourning or rejoicing. That is why I keep coming back to it: beged is not a word to rush past.
